kitEvidence.formula: Aatrox slams his greatsword, dealing [10 / 25 / 40 / 55 / 70 + (0.6 / 0.675 / 0.75 / 0.825 / 0.9) × AD] physical damage. If they are hit on the edge, they are briefly Knocked Up and they take [(10 / 25 / 40 / 55 / 70 + (0.6 / 0.675 / 0.75 / 0.825 / 0.9) × AD) × ((1 + 0.75))] instead. This Ability can be Recast twice, each one changing shape and dealing 25% more damage than the previous one.

builds.name: Deathbringer Stance: target-health magic strike
builds.summary: Investigate high one Deathbringer Stance bonus magic packet output under fixed, reproducible conditions; compare one-slot swaps instead of claiming a global maximum.
builds.goal: Investigate high one Deathbringer Stance bonus magic packet output under fixed, reproducible conditions; compare one-slot swaps instead of claiming a global maximum.
builds.hypothesis: The passive helper scales from 4% to 10% of enemy maximum HP with champion level, with no direct AD or AP coefficient. Penetration and eligible amplification are the experiment; item AP alone does not increase the core percentage. The normal attack delivering the passive and its healing are separate outputs.

kitEvidence.formula:
Aatrox's Attacks deal an additional [characterLevelInterpolation(0.04 → 0.1; raw flags preserved)] max Health magic damage and restore [100]% of damage dealt as Health, reduced to [25]% against minions. This effect has a [characterLevelInterpolation(22 → 10; raw flags preserved)] second cooldown.

Attack and Ability hits against champions and large jungle monsters reduce this effect's cooldown by 2 seconds. Hits with the edge of The Darkin Blade reduce it by 4 seconds instead.
